H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1802: properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down abucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H7768: properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7495: properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H953: a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison)
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H7281: a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H1065: a weeping; by analogy, a dripping
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H4131: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H5641: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H926: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H7845: a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H5826: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
H2015: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H8242: properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H1826: to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish
